findings.excerpt: def HasLocalExtension (q : ℕ) (C : CounterexampleManifold q → ℂ) : Prop :=
findings.problem: HasLocalExtension q C unfolds to exactly HasLocalC1Extension (standardEmbedding q) C, a general predicate defined in C1Coordinates.lean (OAI.Problem340). The two have the same shape: ∀ x, ∃ U open, e x ∈ U, ∃ F, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U ∧ ∀ y, e y ∈ U → f y = F (e y). Here e is standardEmbedding q and the codomain is ℂ. The project already uses HasLocalC1Extension in about 15 files, and its API (prodMk, pi, of_contDiffOn, comp_contDiff) is built on it. This file therefore adds a second, isolated predicate for the same concept. It has no API of its own, and its only extra lemma, hasLocalExtension_of_contDiff, is a special case of HasLocalC1Extension.of_contDiffOn or comp_contDiff. Because the predicates are separate, callers cannot reuse the existing combinators on hypotheses of type HasLocalExtension and would need an unfolding conversion.
findings.proposed_change: Delete HasLocalExtension. Import OAI.Dynamics.EntropyCounterexample.C1Coordinates and state isC1SelfMap_translateCoordinate with (hC : HasLocalC1Extension (standardEmbedding q) C). If a short name is wanted, make it an abbrev for that predicate. Re-derive hasLocalExtension_of_contDiff via HasLocalC1Extension.of_contDiffOn (U := Set.univ), or via comp_contDiff. This should be a small edit to the statements and the obtain at the start of the proof, since the definitions unfold identically.
findings.benefit: There is one notion of local C¹ extension along the embedding, so the existing prodMk, pi and comp_contDiff lemmas apply to translation coefficients without conversion. A reader does not have to check that two near-identical predicates agree, and the codomain-ℂ special case no longer sits apart from the general API.
